tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page base and the well behind progress bars. The darkest ground; everything sits on it.

tokens.name: crypt
tokens.usage: Panels, nav bar, system messages: the main raised ground on void.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Inputs, text areas and secondary-button hover: the ground you write on.

tokens.name: grave
tokens.usage: Pressed states and selected rows on slate or crypt. Never a text ground for blood-ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Thin hard dividers and panel borders on void and crypt. Decorative only: it carries no meaning (1.4:1).

tokens.name: iron
tokens.usage: Tarnished iron: control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, tags), bar-track edges. 3.5:1 on crypt, 3.2:1 on slate.

tokens.name: pewter
tokens.usage: Secondary details: icons, inactive nav, bracket corners on system messages, leaders. 5.8:1 on crypt.

tokens.name: pewter-light
tokens.usage: Secondary-button label, hovered borders, the SYSTEM label. 9.4:1 on crypt, 8.7:1 on slate.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, journal entries, button labels. On void, crypt, slate, blood and blood-deep (11.6:1 or more; 7.2:1 on blood).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, timestamps. On void, crypt, slate and blood-deep (6.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: ash-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels. On void, crypt and slate (4.6:1 on slate). Never for body copy.

tokens.name: blood
tokens.usage: Dried blood: the primary fill. Primary buttons, active-nav marker, the one thing on a screen that must be pressed. Bone text on it.

tokens.name: blood-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a primary button. Bone text on it (6.0:1).

tokens.name: blood-deep
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: the LEVEL UP band, blood tags, warning system messages. Bone, ash or blood-ink text on it.

tokens.name: blood-bar
tokens.usage: Progress-bar fill and the hairlines of a LEVEL UP. A mark, not text: 3.3:1 on void, 3.1:1 on crypt.

tokens.name: blood-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: XP gains, warnings, the active nav label. On void, crypt and blood-deep (4.6:1 or more). On slate only at 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: on-blood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blood or blood-hover fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 11:1 or more on every ground.

families.display: "Libre Caslon Condensed", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The LEVEL UP banner and page-opening words only. 40px/44px below 640px wide. Uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles and section heads. Uppercase.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat levels and big counts. Uppercase, lining figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, stat names, nav. Uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tags, eyebrows, percentages. Uppercase. The smallest display text allowed.

styles.name: entry
styles.sample: Walked the long way home in the rain. Did not stop for the bus.
styles.usage: Journal entries, in the text area and when read back. 17px/28px below 640px. Max 68ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The System has weighed the day and found it sufficient.
styles.usage: Default UI prose and system-message bodies.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis inside body. Never a heading.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The System's spoken verdict line, italic, once per message.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps, counters. ash on any ground.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control's hint; tag padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tag padding-x; stat name to bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked stats; field label to control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; control padding-x; panel padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks; LEVEL UP band padding-y.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page to first title on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: buttons, panels, bars, tags. Hard edges.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Inputs and text areas only, to take the knife-edge off at 1x.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Not a radius for rounding: the size of a worn, cut corner on panels and primary buttons (clip-path chamfer).

shadow.note: Shadows only press things down; nothing glows. No coloured shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels floating on void.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Inputs, text areas and bar tracks: cut into the stone.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Active (pressed) buttons.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Film grain over surfaces. Never above 0.08: text must stay clean.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Darkness of the page vignette at the corners.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and focus colour changes. The fastest anything moves.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Panels and messages fading in.

tokens.name: duration-fill
tokens.usage: Progress bars filling.

tokens.name: duration-ceremony
tokens.usage: The whole LEVEL UP banner, from band to text.

tokens.name: ease-weight
tokens.usage: Fades and colour changes: starts at once, settles slowly.

tokens.name: ease-grind
tokens.usage: Bars filling and rules drawing: a slow start, a long heavy stop. No overshoot ever.
